notes: Fixes a broker load job that, on a pending task retry, failed against a label held by its own prepared transaction, and adds tests for it. testBeginTxnRethrowsForeignLabelConflict checks that a label held by another job still fails with the standard idiom: try { brokerLoadJob.beginTxn(); Assert.fail("expected LabelAlreadyUsedException"); } catch (LabelAlreadyUsedException expected) { }, followed by an assertEquals on the job's transaction id after the enclosing try with resources block. Accepted under ADR 0007 Decision 8: a try whose last statement is fail(...) is not caught by rule 1, the catch type is not Throwable, Error, AssertionError or AssertionFailedError, the try block assigns nothing a later assertion reads, and an assertion follows in the method body. The production change adds a catch that logs and conditionally rethrows, and widens another catch that logs, so no production flag applies. The PR's flaky fixes are in Groovy regression suites, which a Java fixture cannot carry, so the target is the test that uses the idiom. Kept: every hunk of BrokerLoadJob.java and BrokerLoadJobTest.java; the Groovy suites, a Groovy plugin and an SQL file are dropped. Each of the PR's commits carries an AI co-author trailer; the change was reviewed and merged by the project's maintainers and is used as a real merged change, recorded as such. Not from IDoFT: neither the PR nor the test class appears in pr-data.csv under any status.
